findings.text: the digest short-circuit returns None before the unanswered-findings refusal at reckon/crew/routing.py:2841-2849, so a launch of a queued request passes a plan whose review leaves findings unanswered while a fresh direct dispatch on the same plan refuses it. Reproduced at the reviewed head in a scratch extraction: with a design review carrying finding F1 and no response, _launch returned None and _direct returned 'the review of plan ... leaves 1 finding(s) unanswered: F1'. This contradicts the plan section's done-when ('each launch's verdict equals the verdict of a fresh direct dispatch at the same moment') and is a regression against the base, where review_coverage ran unconditionally before the same refusal. Remedy: reuse only the coverage computation and its record, and keep the unanswered-findings check after it.

in the edit=False parametrization both sides of 'assert _launch(repo, node) == _direct(repo, node)' are None, so the assertion holds whatever the code does and could not have caught the divergence above; the arm that would carry weight (a state where the two verdicts differ) is absent.
